name: CI: production build
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-build.yml. Produces a production build (npm and/or composer) and optionally uploads the result as an artifact for downstream CD jobs. Stable (merged into release/v1.0.0).

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Default 'v1' tracks the v1 line; pin to a SHA in security-sensitive repos.
PHP version (used only when install-composer-deps is true).
Install Composer dependencies before the build. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
Upload the build output as a GitHub Actions artifact. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
